messages:
ivan: Morning team — async standup. What I did yesterday: iterated on the multi-AZ warmup script and validated warmup behavior with the new KV cache warmup flag in staging. Also fixed node-labeler race that caused warmup tasks to land on tainted nodes. Blockers: still seeing a 150–300ms tail on small prompts in eu-west under 1.5k qps — logs don't show cache misses. Need Kevin to drop the rt-trace for those traces. Today: plan to push warmup to eu-west-1 and run a 30m soak; will also open a small rollback-policy tweak (see PR) and a quota ask for ap-southeast-2.

lisa: nice! can you drop the staging run id? also flagged your PR for review. Staging run: warmup-id=warmup-2026-03-16-21. saw the node-labeler fix, lgtm. re: tail latency — could be kernel scheduling noise; i'll instrument the kubelet metrics and add a quick cpu-iso check.

kevin: i pushed a short rt-trace for the window you mentioned — it's at /runs/trace-4850012-rt.log. early look: some kv-cache GC spikes aligned with a pod restart from the node auto-upgrade. i can try pinning nodes to avoid upgrades during soak. also +1 on the quota ask; need region owner approval (cc @sophia).

sophia: approved for a temporary soft quota bump in ap-southeast-2 for 2 weeks, up to 8 gpus. file a ticket with cost estimate and autoscaler params. i've opened INF-7809 to track. please add the expected GPU-hours delta.

ivan: thanks — filing ticket now. quick note on autoscaler params i'm planning to use:
```
minReplicas: 2
maxReplicas: 12
targetUtilization: 0.7
scaleUpDelay: 15s
scaleDownGrace: 180s
```
expect ~+5% GPU-hours during the soak. tagging @lisa for the kubelet metric graph.

lisa: received. i'll add the kubelet panel and a pod restart-rate graph to the dashboard. quick CR ping: @lisa please review PR #4023 (multi-az warmup + rollback-policy). small change: added a configurable backoff for KV priming.

devops: tilt-bot: deploy queued: warmup-job-staging -> starting canary.

deploy-bot: canary started for warmup-job-staging (canary id c-4850012). i'll post results in 30m. :rocket:

kevin: one more ask — can we avoid spot fallbacks during the soak? if spot eviction causes node churn we'll lose the test signal. suggest temporarily prefer-on-demand:true for the queue.

ivan: good call. switching to prefer-on-demand for the soak window. i'll update INF-7809 with that and the rollback window (1h). thanks all :thumbsup:
